home.eyebrow: Multi-tenant platform for government and private entities
home.lead: Operate projects, resources, and compliance in one interface built for the Saudi market.
home.p1Body: Track stages, tasks, and budgets at a density suited to institutional teams.
home.p2Body: Employee records, IDs, and job titles under organization policies.
home.p3Body: Extension-ready hooks: Muqeem, Qiwa, GOSI, Mudad, Absher.
home.visionBody: Designed to support governance and privacy readiness without claiming unearned certifications.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Operational capabilities for organizations and government entities.
features.f1Body: Compact project, task, and budget indicators for daily review.
features.f2Body: National ID, residency number, and job titles in Kingdom formats.
features.f3Body: Isolated organization data with central platform administration.
features.f4Body: Basic, Professional, Enterprise, and Government plans with 15% VAT.
features.f5Body: A clear path from the public site to platform follow-up.
features.f6Body: RTL by default with English secondary and Western numerals.
features.integrations: Extension-ready hooks (labels only): Muqeem · Qiwa · GOSI · Mudad · Absher

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Indicative monthly prices for the demo. Final pricing is contractual.
pricing.basicBody: Up to 15 seats and limited projects for smaller organizations.
pricing.proBody: Up to 50 seats with operational reports and stage tracking.
pricing.entBody: Unlimited seats and dedicated support for large entities.
pricing.vatNote: 15% VAT is added to all financial invoices.
